The Hollow Tree

Winter is coming

Somebody has been raiding the nut stash. All that’s left is a cracked shell and a suspicious, tail-shaped smudge.

The squirrels can’t guard it alone. They need a crew with sharp eyes, quick paws and big hearts.

1,555 HOOD NUTTS are 1,555 seats on the branches of the great tree. Hold one and you’re crew. The more of us there are, the safer the stash.

The field guide

Overview

HOOD NUTTS is a universe and IP on Robinhood Chain: 1,555 squirrels with a retro-gaming, autumn-survival theme, a free mint, and utility built around a game and token-bound vaults.

Every NFT is a seat on a branch of the Hollow Tree. Holders are the crew that keeps the stash safe until spring.

Mint

  • Mint supply: 1,555
  • Chain: Robinhood Chain
  • Launchpad: OpenSea
  • Traits: 150, with 20 one-of-ones
  • Mint phases: GTD free mint / FCFS TBA
  • Date TBA

The mint is free: you don’t pay for the NFT itself.

Token-bound vaults

Every NFT has its own ERC-6551 vault. The vault collects scheduled $NUTTS drops over time. The vault checker shows what’s inside; it is locked for now and opens at launch.

$NUTTS

30% of the $NUTTS supply is reserved for long-term holders. Full details will be published here first.

Branch Dash

A playable mini-game where the squirrel outruns the nut thieves. Play it on the home page. More game rewards for the community are planned.

Whitelist

Finish the five quests on the whitelist page: follow, like, repost, comment and quote-retweet. Then add your X handle and wallet address. Winners are announced on X.

Collabs

We’re looking for partner projects to grow the crew together. For a collab to be valid:

  • The giveaway link must be shared when it’s live.
  • The winners list is sent within 72 hours.
  • Your community is ready to stash their Nutts!

FAQ

Is the mint really free?

Yes. Anyone can join the crew without paying for the NFT itself.

When is the mint?

The date is TBA. Announcements land on X first.

What chain is it on?

Robinhood Chain.

What do vaults do?

Each NFT’s ERC-6551 vault collects scheduled $NUTTS drops over time.
